build.overlap: Same precompiled Hermes -O bytecode on all hosts

clock: __now when available; otherwise Date.now. Calibration >=50ms, median of seven samples.
order: Three complete 33-case invocations per host. Rounds 1 and 3 before/after/magrinj; round 2 reverses. No builds or profiling during timings.
outputChecks: 297 values checked. All FormatJS before/after values match. Only comparator differences: omitted/unsupported ListFormat default locale en-US versus en.
controls: Added omitted locales, prebuilt locale-array input, explicit empty options. Constructor outputs check resolved locale outside timing; explicit options retain original matching/getter ordering.

conformance.gates: Ten targeted Rust, bridge, type, TS/Rust, Hermes, Test262 and ICU4C/J/X tests pass
conformance.abi: New owned constructor tested with empty/fallback/multiple requests, registry replacement/destruction and malformed JSON/output clearing
conformance.observableBehavior: Omitted options ignore Object.prototype.type; explicit empty options still invoke inherited type getter
conformance.consumer: Rebuilt SDK consumer passes nine API smoke scripts and 69 Collator fixtures

limits: Array-input and explicit-options ListFormat constructors remain slower than optimized magrinj. Most steady-state API gaps remain. No claim of overall goal completion.

commands.benchmark: bazel build -c opt //benchmarks/hermes-intl-extension:overlap_bytecode; run the cquery artifact on each pinned optimized host
